# Extractor SDK API

The public API of the `projections-extractor-sdk` crate. Read with the `rust-public-api` extractor from rustdoc's
JSON output (nightly-2026-09-17), the same way it shows your crates' APIs; descriptions are the sources' documentation
comments. Start with [the guide](../../packages/extractors/sdk/README.md).

> Write Projections extractors in Rust: the extractor request and process, repository paths and extraction values. Every built-in extractor is written with this crate and nothing else from Projections; see the README.

### `canonical`

```rust
pub fn canonical(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf>
```

`fs::canonicalize`, without the `\\?\` verbatim prefix Windows adds whenever the
ordinary spelling denotes the same path. Tools such as MSBuild can't expand
wildcards under verbatim paths, so every path handed to a tool uses this.

### `main`

```rust
pub fn main(extractor: &str, collect: impl FnOnce(&Context) -> Result<Value>) -> ExitCode
```

Runs an extractor process: reads the request on stdin, calls `collect` and
writes its extraction on stdout, or its failure on stderr with a nonzero exit.

```no_run
use projections_extractor_sdk::{Context, extraction, key, read_source, relationship};
use serde_json::json;

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    projections_extractor_sdk::main("flags", |cx: &Context| {
        let mut entities = vec![];
        let mut relationships = vec![];
        for file in cx.files()?.iter().filter(|file| file.ends_with("flags.txt")) {
            let owner = format!("file:{file}");
            entities.push(json!({"id": owner, "kind": "file", "label": file}));
            for flag in read_source(cx.root(), file)?.lines().filter(|line| !line.is_empty()) {
                let id = key(&["flag", flag]);
                entities.push(json!({"id": id, "kind": "flag", "label": flag}));
                relationships.push(relationship("declares", &owner, &id));
            }
        }
        Ok(extraction("graph/v0", entities, relationships, None))
    })
}
```

### `project_path`

```rust
pub fn project_path(project: &str, relative: &str) -> Result<String>
```

`relative`, a path in the project `project` (repository-relative, empty for
the repository's root), as a repository-relative `/`-separated path, joined
lexically: `.` and empty segments drop, and each `..` climbs one directory,
out of the project if it must, but never out of the repository. The project
itself is `project`; the repository's root is empty.

## Types

### `Access`

```rust
pub enum Access
```

What an extractor needs of the examined revision.

| Member | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `as_str` | `pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str` |  |
| `Checkout` | `Checkout` | A directory holding the revision, for tools that read it themselves. |
| `Files` | `Files` | Only file reads through the `crate::Context` (`files`, `entry`, `read_source`): the runner may serve them from Git objects, with nothing on disk, and enforce a scope. |

### `Basis`

```rust
pub struct Basis(_)
```

What a generated value was generated from: named parts, each a hash or a
short verbatim string such as a model ID.

| Member | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `digest` | `pub fn digest(&self) -> String` | The basis digest: `sha256:` over its canonical JSON. |
| `hash` | `pub fn hash(self, name: &str, text: &str) -> Result<Self>` | Adds a part hashed from `text`, such as the source the model read or the prompt. |
| `hash_json` | `pub fn hash_json(self, name: &str, value: &Value) -> Result<Self>` | Adds a part hashed from a JSON value's canonical form. |
| `keep` | `pub fn keep(self, name: &str, value: &str) -> Result<Self>` | Adds a part kept as written, such as a pinned model ID. |
| `new` | `pub fn new() -> Self` |  |
| `to_value` | `pub fn to_value(&self) -> Value` | The basis as the extraction records it. |

### `Context`

```rust
pub struct Context { .. }
```

One extractor invocation: the public extractor request and what this process
was given. An extractor reads everything it needs from here, so it works the
same whoever starts it.

| Member | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `checkout` | `pub fn checkout(&self) -> Result<PathBuf>` | Where the project's dependencies (such as `node_modules`) are installed for this run: the project's directory in the root itself in place or in a prepared workspace, or in the user's working checkout when a materialized revision borrows them. |
| `compare` | `pub fn compare(&self, request: &ComparisonRequest<'_>) -> Result<Value>` | The comparison of two extractions (normalized, of one domain schema) by the default comparator or a comparator file, validated against them: for an extractor whose data includes comparisons, such as fixture scenarios. The runner computes it in the same sandbox as any comparison, so it runs no repository code and needs no trust. Only runners that provide the service (the `projections` CLI, for its built-in extractors) can; others fail with an error saying so. |
| `definition` | `pub fn definition(&self) -> &Value` | The projection definition. |
| `diagnose` | `pub fn diagnose(&self, text: &str)` | Adds text to the diagnostics written to stderr when the extractor finishes. |
| `diagnostics` | `pub fn diagnostics(&self) -> String` | The diagnostics recorded so far, bounded. |
| `directory` | `pub fn directory(&self) -> Option<&Path>` | The project's directory, or `None` when the revision is read from Git objects. |
| `entry` | `pub fn entry(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<FileEntry>` | One of the revision's files: whether it is a symlink, and its size. |
| `environment` | `pub fn environment(&self, names: &[String]) -> BTreeMap<String, String>` | The base tool environment (a UTF-8 locale, UTC, `PATH` and `SystemRoot`) plus each of `names` this process received. |
| `exists` | `pub fn exists(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool>` | Whether `relative` is a file or directory of the examined revision: one of its files, or a directory some file is inside. A path Git ignores in a checkout isn't part of the revision. |
| `extractor` | `pub fn extractor(&self) -> &str` | The name of the extractor this process runs. |
| `files` | `pub fn files(&self) -> Result<&[String]>` | The project's files, as project-relative POSIX paths in byte order: everything materialized under it, what Git lists in a checkout (tracked and untracked, not ignored), or the Git tree's blobs; only those in the scope when one is declared. Files outside the project aren't listed, but a scope that includes them lets them be read with `..` paths. |
| `finish` | `pub fn finish(&self, extraction: Value) -> Value` | `extraction` with the missing inputs recorded during the run, as its `missingInputs`. `crate::serve` applies it to what an extractor returns. |
| `generations` | `pub fn generations(&self) -> Generations` | The generation store's snapshot the runner handed this run (`request.generations.file`), or an empty one: the first run, `--regenerate`, or an unreadable file. Reuse a value for an equal basis with `crate::Generations::generate`. |
| `granted` | `pub fn granted(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>>` | The names the definition grants through `execution.environment`. |
| `helper` | `pub fn helper(&self, installed: &str, source: PathBuf) -> Result<PathBuf>` | Locates a helper file or directory: `installed` relative to the helper directory, or `source`, its location in a source checkout. |
| `helper_directory` | `pub fn helper_directory(&self) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>>` | The extractor's helper directory, or `None` when its helpers are in their source locations. |
| `input_exists` | `pub fn input_exists(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool>` | Whether the declared input `relative` (a file or folder an input names) exists at the examined revision. One that doesn't is recorded as missing: the revision predates it, or it was removed, so the extraction describes the revision without it and says so (`Context::finish`) rather than failing. |
| `is_dir` | `pub fn is_dir(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool>` | Whether `relative` (in the project) is a directory of the revision: some file is inside it. |
| `missing_input` | `pub fn missing_input(&self, input: &str)` | Records a declared input the examined revision lacks: a path that doesn't exist, or a glob that matches no file. |
| `missing_inputs` | `pub fn missing_inputs(&self) -> Vec<String>` | The declared inputs recorded as missing, in byte order. |
| `mode` | `pub fn mode(&self) -> &str` | How the runner gave this extractor the revision: `materialized`, `in-place`, `workspace` or `git-objects`. |
| `new` | `pub fn new(extractor: &str, request: Value) -> Result<Self>` | The context for `request`, run by the extractor named `extractor`, with this process's environment, running tools as child processes and with no helper directory. |
| `project` | `pub fn project(&self) -> &str` | The definition's project, relative to the repository's root (`repository.project`); empty for the root. |
| `read` | `pub fn read(extractor: &str) -> Result<Self>` | The context for the request on stdin. |
| `read_bytes` | `pub fn read_bytes(&self, relative: &str, maximum: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>>` | The bytes of a regular file of the revision, at most `maximum`; never through a symlink. |
| `read_json` | `pub fn read_json(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<Value>` | A JSON file of the revision, parsed by the Engine. |
| `read_source` | `pub fn read_source(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<String>` | A UTF-8 file of the revision (at most 32 MiB), as `crate::read_source` reads one. |
| `repository_files` | `pub fn repository_files(&self) -> Result<&[String]>` | The examined revision's files in the scope, repository-relative, in byte order. |
| `repository_path` | `pub fn repository_path(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<String>` | `relative`, a path in the project (`..` may leave it, but not the repository), as a repository-relative path. |
| `repository_root` | `pub fn repository_root(&self) -> Option<&Path>` | The examined revision's root directory, or `None` when it is read from Git objects. |
| `request` | `pub fn request(&self) -> &Value` | The request, with its repository root canonicalized. |
| `require_trust` | `pub fn require_trust(&self) -> Result<()>` | Fails unless the invocation is trusted; call it immediately before running ecosystem tools or repository code. |
| `root` | `pub fn root(&self) -> &Path` | The project's directory in the examined revision, canonicalized: in a temporary materialization, a workspace or the user's checkout read in place. It is the revision's root unless the definition belongs to a nested project (`repository.project`). |
| `run` | `pub fn run(&self, cwd: &Path, argv: &[String], stdin: Option<&str>, environment: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Result<Output>` | Runs a tool without a shell and records its stderr as a diagnostic. |
| `scope` | `pub fn scope(&self) -> Option<&[String]>` | The declared scope, when the runner enforces one: repository-relative files and directories. Files outside it aren't listed and can't be read. |
| `trusted` | `pub fn trusted(&self) -> bool` | Whether the invocation explicitly trusts repository code and ecosystem tools. |
| `upstream` | `pub fn upstream(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&Value>` | The extraction of the upstream built-in the definition's `extractor.upstream` names `name`, normalized, of the same revision. |
| `with_comparisons` | `pub fn with_comparisons(self, comparisons: impl Fn(&ComparisonRequest<'_>) -> Result<Value> + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self` | Compares extractions with `comparisons`, the runner's comparator sandbox, for `Context::compare`. Without it, `compare` fails. |
| `with_environment` | `pub fn with_environment(self, environment: BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Self` | Replaces the environment variables this extractor reads. |
| `with_files` | `pub fn with_files(self, files: Vec<String>) -> Self` | Uses `files` (repository-relative) as the revision's files instead of walking the root. |
| `with_helpers` | `pub fn with_helpers(self, resolve: impl Fn() -> Result<Option<PathBuf>> + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self` | Locates the extractor's own helper files: `resolve` returns their directory, or `None` when they are in their source locations. It runs on each `Context::helper` lookup, so it can verify the files every time. |
| `with_tools` | `pub fn with_tools(self, tools: impl Fn(&Invocation<'_>) -> Result<Output> + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self` | Runs tools with `tools` instead of as child processes. |

### `Determinism`

```rust
pub enum Determinism
```

How reproducible an extractor's output is, like a test's: declared and
descriptive, never enforced. `projections check` measures it by rerunning.

| Member | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `as_str` | `pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str` |  |
| `Environmental` | `Environmental` | The files plus the toolchain and installed dependencies: reproducible within one environment, so it is cached only within the same environment fingerprint. The default for custom extractors. |
| `Observed` | `Observed` | Live or varying data, such as timings or coverage: each run is an observation, never reused silently. |
| `parse` | `pub fn parse(value: &str) -> Option<Self>` | The class named `value`. |
| `Pure` | `Pure` | A function of the revision's files alone: the same tree always gives the same extraction, so it is cached by tree and a rerun must match. |
